rows.label: bf08430100_0010
rows.name: You can't control it, can you?

rows.label: bf08430100_0020
rows.name:
So you've been appointed Cardinal Deacon.
Congratulations.

rows.label: bf08430100_0040
rows.name: I just came to say goodbye.

rows.label: bf08430100_0050
rows.name:
You'd be in a tough spot if
I vanished without warning.

rows.label: bf08430100_0060
rows.name: Goodbye? What are you going to do if you leave me?

rows.label: bf08430100_0080
rows.name: I... can use all my power on my own.

rows.label: bf08430100_0085
rows.name: I'll keep existing even if [System:Ruby rt=You ]Driver[/System:Ruby] dies.

rows.label: bf08430100_0100
rows.name:
The Holy See and its believers are contemptible
fools. Humans are nothing but waste in this world.

rows.label: bf08430100_0110
rows.name:
I figured I'd help you achieve
that desire of yours.

rows.label: bf08430100_0140
rows.name:
That's why you sought the supreme being...
God, and climbed the World Tree.

rows.label: bf08430100_0170
rows.name:
Someone out there must be able
to use this Core Crystal...

rows.label: bf08430100_0180
rows.name: I'll have that person handle Metsu...
